literal_meaning: ফাঁদে পা রাখা (to step into a trap)
figurative_meaning_en: To fall into a trap or conspiracy
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বন্ধুর কথায় ফাঁদে পা দিয়ে বিপদে পড়েছে।
ব্যবসায়িক চুক্তিতে ফাঁদে পা দেওয়া উচিত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He fell into the trap by trusting his friend's words and got into trouble.
One should not step into a trap in a business deal.
note: This idiom draws from imagery of hunting traps, common in rural Bengali life, emphasizing caution against deceit.
